releases.notes: ## RavenNest 0.1.1+26.2 ### Features - **DPS Tracker** now tracking and showing your damage-per-second output, with configurable position and toggle in the config screen. > Note: This feature is experimental. The damage detection might misse some of your damages, or take into account team mates damages... - **Entity Hitbox** its now possible do activate entity hitbox & entity supporting block from the Debug Menu (`F3 + F6`) directly from the configuration panel (`/rn config`). ### Fixes - Fixed the item sell price overlay showing the no value when the price is exactly one crown. ### Misc - Added an `Expert Settings` category, where you can tune the damage detection settings used by the DPS Tracker.

releases.notes: ## RavenNest 0.1.0+26.2 First release of RavenNest, a client-side helper mod for the **Ravenguard** gamemode on **Hypixel**. ### Features - **Item rarity background**: colored background behind items based on their rarity, toggleable separately for the hotbar and the inventory. - **Sell price overlay**: display items sell price directly on items slots. - **In-game config screen** via `/rn config` or `/ravennest config`, with optional [ModMenu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) integration. ### Compatibility - Minecraft 26.2 - Fabric Loader 0.19.3+ - Requires Fabric API and YetAnotherConfigLib (YACL) ### Notes This is an early build — expect rough edges and rapid changes. Bug reports and feedback are welcome.
